note: All 33 composers covered. The input held no benchmarks or violin-catalogue entries. Naxos Music Library was not reachable. IMSLP's 'recorded' signals were checked on Deezer, Apple Music, MusicBrainz and web searches; the last sweep used Apple's composer-attribute search, which found recordings that Deezer, MusicBrainz and IMSLP missed (Labor Op. 3 and Op. 6 on Capriccio C5390, Fitzenhagen's Concert-Walzer, Arnold Mendelssohn's Op. 76 trio), so the 19 pages skipped as 'not performed or recorded' rest on negative lookups and are weaker for small labels. Blumenfeld, Weber's quintet and Wilfrid d'Indy were confirmed through web searches (Profil 2015, Cello Classics CC1017, Marco Polo 8.223691). Fifteen recorded works that IMSLP lacks were added from discs I opened (Sinigaglia String Trio, Heise Quartets 1/5/6, Labor Trio in E minor, Frühling Op. 3, Norman Op. 10 and Op. 42, Thuille Quartet No. 1 and Piano Quintet No. 1, Børresen Quartet No. 2, Krug Piano Quartet, Cadman Piano Quintet, Radecke Piano Trio No. 1, Hamerik Piano Quintet); their years are blank where I found none. Left out for lack of a confirmed scoring: Sinigaglia's Romanza Op. 3, Radecke's Op. 7 Fantasiestücke, Norman's Piano Sextet Op. 29 (Kiyo Wada, 2025), a second Labor 'Piano Quintet in D major'. Open points: Arnold Mendelssohn's Op. 67 (key and number differ by source; title left without them); Krug's piano quartet (Op. 16 on the CPO disc, Op. 17 on Wikipedia); numbering of Norman's quartets.
